author: Insta360
description:
In August 2025, The Dorothy Project partnered with the Canadian Space Agency’s STRATOS program to send a scientific gondola nearly 40 kilometers above Earth. 🌍

Onboard: environmental experiments, research instruments, and an Insta360 Titan engineered to capture true stereoscopic 3D 360 footage from the edge of space.

Operating in near-vacuum conditions, extreme temperature swings, and high-G landing forces, Titan recorded continuously throughout ascent, float altitude, and descent.

The result: immersive 3D VR footage revealing Earth’s curvature from near space.

This marks the first time Insta360 Titan has operated at the edge of space.

Experience the mission. Step into space.

Learn more about Titan: https://bit.ly/DorothyYouTube
Learn more about the Dorothy Project: https://bit.ly/DorothyProject
